name: spoond-patience
request: When spoond is full it answers with 503 (capacity_wait) or 429 (box_full) and a Retry-After header. The spoond driver gives up after six tries, which is under a minute when Retry-After is short, so a busy moment fails threads that would have got a sandbox by waiting a little longer. Make it keep trying for up to ten minutes, still following Retry-After (at most 60 seconds a wait), and make that limit an option of SpoondDriver: `patience`, in seconds, 600 by default. When the patience runs out, return spoond's last answer, as it does now when it gives up.
